environment.notes: Raced at night under floodlights. Air temperature is an estimate of a typical race evening (October, equatorial). Pressure is the ISA value at the lap's mean altitude. Session times are the 2025 event's local start times. The floodlight masts are not mapped in OpenStreetMap (one tower and no lamps within the circuit's bounding box), so they are placed by rule (estimates): a mast every 40 m along each side, the two sides staggered by 20 m, 1 m behind the wall, 10 m tall.

dem.filter: opening 400 m, moving average 90 m, Gaussian sigma 20 m

source.estimates: Widths, banking, kerbs, run-off kinds nearest the track, barrier types and offsets not mapped in OpenStreetMap, pit-lane widths, limit lines, boxes and grid slots are authored estimates.

timingLine.source: FIA 2025 Singapore circuit map: the map's drawn track fitted to this centreline with tools/research/map_fit.py (similarity transform, median miss 2.7 m) and the control-line tick projected onto it; 128.6 m before the start line. Under the same fit the speed-trap, sector 1 and sector 2 ticks land 8.3, 0.8 and 9.0 m from their stored positions, hence +/- 10 m.
